# Historical paper records

These records are outside the active paper workflow. Existing posterior archives,
original producer source snapshots and pilot evidence retain their original bytes.
`former_entrypoints/` preserves the removed dispatchers and wrappers; use the
case scripts in `paper/` for current reproduction.

Current protein samples live at `paper/protein/data/{cnt,cnt_grd}/`. Paths recorded
inside old archives describe their original checkout, not the current layout.

`retired_moments_and_growth_figures_20261028.zip` preserves the removed
moments paper case, three obsolete growth PNG/receipt pairs and their original
captions/plot support. `MANIFEST.json` records original paths and SHA-256 hashes.
Only the active paper selection changed; the manual's moment case is retained.
